_comment: Identity measurements supplied by ch32rv. Mask revision bits [7:4]. An ID read alone does not establish flash capacity or programming support; `flash_verified` names the ch32rv record of an erase + program + readback that matched on that part (2026-10-22: CH32M030G8R7 and CH32V407WEU6 over an OEP probe, 1-wire SWIO). `documented_wrong` (a reason) lets a measurement replace an EVT ID it contradicts: the row keeps the measured ID, turns conflict and keeps the EVT value as a `!` source (2026-11-04: CH32V103C8T6, ch32rv 0011). Entries without `attach_id` record a memory read only.

CH32V103C8T6.documented_wrong: EVT lists 0x25004102 for CH32V103C8T, but a CH32V103C8T6 (LQFP48) reads 0x2500410F, the same ID as CH32V103R8T6; the ID does not tell C8T6 from R8T6, and no V103 returning 0x25004102 has been seen

CH32V103R8T6.remark: CH32V103C8T6 reads the same ID, so the ID does not tell R8T6 from C8T6
